verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a legal services firm, not a software or data-hosting product, so letting a user choose a data storage region is a category error for this kind of product. Its privacy practice advises clients on GDPR and other data-protection laws, but that is legal counsel, not a user-selectable residency capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
